title: Oil Surges as Saudi Pipeline Shutdown Brings Fresh Supply Risk
description:
Oil surged as Saudi Arabia’s closure of a major crude pipeline following attacks jolted the market, with the move disrupting a route that’s been key to bypassing the Strait of Hormuz during the US-Iran war. Bloomberg's Rob Barnett joins to discuss.
